Title: Credential phishing leads to mailbox takeover
Description: A phishing actor captures credentials and session tokens, then uses the mailbox for invoice fraud and internal phishing.
RecommendedControls: Phishing-resistant MFA for admins; token protection; automated phishing triage; inbox-rule forwarding detection

Title: Unsupported server operating systems
Description: Two file servers run Windows Server 2012 R2 with no security updates, exposing known remotely exploitable flaws.
RecommendedControls: Migrate to Server 2022; isolate in a restricted VLAN until migration; EDR in block mode

Title: Delayed deprovisioning of departing staff
Description: Termination requests submitted late in the week are processed after the weekend, leaving accounts active beyond the 24-hour SLA.
RecommendedControls: HR-driven automated disable; weekend on-call coverage; weekly SLA report

Title: Ransomware encrypts on-premises file shares
Description: Malware executed by a user spreads over SMB and encrypts shared drives and reachable backups.
RecommendedControls: Immutable backup copy; ASR rules; restrict SMB lateral movement; quarterly restore test

Title: Illicit OAuth consent grants
Description: Users can consent to third-party apps requesting mail and file scopes, giving attackers persistent API access.
RecommendedControls: Restrict user consent to verified publishers; admin consent workflow; consent detection rule

Title: Third-party payroll provider breach
Description: A breach at the payroll SaaS vendor exposes employee PII and bank details.
RecommendedControls: Vendor SOC 2 Type II review; breach notification clause; cyber insurance

Title: Critical vulnerabilities exceed remediation SLA
Description: High-severity findings on workstations stay open past 30 days because of failed patch deployments.
RecommendedControls: Weekly remediation SLA dashboard; auto-retry deployment rings; exception process

Title: Unsigned administrative scripts
Description: Scripts run with admin rights from shared folders without integrity checks; a tampered script would run silently.
RecommendedControls: Enforce AllSigned via GPO; script block logging; restrict share write access

Title: Sensitive data shared externally
Description: Users share files containing PII with external parties through anonymous links.
RecommendedControls: Disable anonymous links; sensitivity labels; DLP policy for PII

Title: Single administrator dependency
Description: One person holds the knowledge and credentials for firewall and backup administration.
RecommendedControls: Document runbooks; second admin trained; break-glass procedure
